svg.title: Writing લ — પ — ચ — બ
svg.desc: 4 letters written one after another: લ, પ, ચ, બ (gujarati). Each letter has its own group of frames; frame N of a group shows movements 1 to N of that letter, the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansGujarati-Static.ttf. Each letter is drawn at its own scale from its own cited stroke order, so the strip does not show how large the letters are next to each other, how far apart they sit, or any join between them. Stroke order: લ: t30apps.com, ‘Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice’, version 1.0, લ animation, first through third SVG paths <https://www.t30apps.com/gujarati-alphabet-writing/>; પ: t30apps.com, ‘Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice’, version 1.0, પ animation, first and second SVG paths <https://www.t30apps.com/gujarati-alphabet-writing/>; ચ: t30apps.com, ‘Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice’, version 1.0, ચ animation, first and second SVG paths <https://www.t30apps.com/gujarati-alphabet-writing/>; બ: t30apps.com, ‘Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice’, version 1.0, બ animation, first and second SVG paths <https://www.t30apps.com/gujarati-alphabet-writing/>. Source notes on variation: લ: The teaching app animates લ as three ordered pen-down runs. Its first SVG path begins at the upper right, circles counterclockwise around the broad rounded left body, and finishes at its lower-right terminal. The animation lifts once and its second SVG path sweeps the separate middle shoulder from left to right. It lifts again and its third SVG path descends the separate tall right spine before turning through the lower-right foot. The remaining path slots are empty. The app explicitly says that depicted forms and stroke orders can differ by source and should be treated as one variant, not a universal standard. The bundled Noto Sans Gujarati glyph preserves the broad rounded body, middle shoulder, tall right spine, and lower foot, but its printed body is wider, its shoulder rises diagonally, and its spine is straighter than the animated school-hand form. This learner path preserves the source's rounded-body-before-middle-shoulder-before-right-spine order and two-lift evidence while fitting all three runs to the font's ink. Individual handwriting may narrow, round, simplify, retrace, join, or slant the body, shoulder, spine, foot, and terminals differently. પ: The teaching app animates પ as two ordered pen-down runs. Its first SVG path begins at the high left hook, curls upward and right over that hook, descends the left stem, then sweeps right around the broad lower body and rises into the right shoulder. The animation lifts once and its second SVG path descends the separate tall right spine before turning through the lower-right foot. The remaining path slots are empty. The app explicitly says that depicted forms and stroke orders can differ by source and should be treated as one variant, not a universal standard. The bundled Noto Sans Gujarati glyph preserves the high left hook, left stem, broad lower body, right shoulder, tall right spine, and lower foot, but its printed hook and body are wider and its spine straighter than the animated school-hand form. This learner path preserves the source's hooked-body-before-right-spine order and one-lift evidence while fitting both runs to the font's ink. Individual handwriting may narrow, round, simplify, retrace, or slant the hook, stem, body, shoulder, spine, foot, and terminals differently. ચ: The teaching app animates ચ as two ordered pen-down runs. Its first SVG path begins at the upper left, circles clockwise around the upper bowl, turns through the small middle loop, then continues clockwise around the broad lower body and finishes at its upper right. The animation lifts once and its second SVG path descends the full right spine before turning through its lower foot. The remaining path slots are empty. The app explicitly says that depicted forms and stroke orders can differ by source and should be treated as one variant, not a universal standard. The bundled Noto Sans Gujarati glyph preserves the upper bowl, middle loop, broad lower body, and tall right spine, but its printed bowls are broader and the spine foot more angular than the animated school-hand form. This learner path preserves the source's joined-body-before-right-spine order and one-lift evidence while fitting both runs to the font's ink. Individual handwriting may narrow, round, simplify, retrace, or slant the bowls, loop, spine, and terminals differently. બ: The teaching app animates બ as two ordered pen-down runs. Its first SVG path begins near the upper left, circles clockwise around the rounded left body, winds inward through the compact middle turn, then exits right across the shoulder. The animation lifts once and its second SVG path descends the separate tall right spine before turning through the lower-right foot. The remaining path slots are empty. The app explicitly says that depicted forms and stroke orders can differ by source and should be treated as one variant, not a universal standard. The bundled Noto Sans Gujarati glyph preserves the rounded left body, compact inner turn, right shoulder, tall right spine, and lower foot, but its printed body is wider, its turn more angular, and its spine straighter than the animated school-hand form. This learner path preserves the source's rounded-body-before-right-spine order and one-lift evidence while fitting both runs to the font's ink. Individual handwriting may narrow, round, simplify, retrace, or slant the body, turn, shoulder, spine, foot, and terminals differently.
svg.text: How it is written — 4 letters, one after another
Letter 1 of 4 — 3 strokes · 2 pen lifts · 3 movements
Letter 1: stroke order after t30apps.com, ‘Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice’, version 1.0, લ animation, first through third SVG paths
Letter 2: stroke order after t30apps.com, ‘Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice’, version 1.0, પ animation, first and second SVG paths
Letter 3: stroke order after t30apps.com, ‘Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice’, version 1.0, ચ animation, first and second SVG paths
Letter 4: stroke order after t30apps.com, ‘Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice’, version 1.0, બ animation, first and second SVG paths
This order is attested, not standardised; the source records where it varies.
